sentences.sentence: We're a small Instagram content studio dedicated to bringing creative energy to the travel space.

We'd like to propose a collaborative Instagram post that builds on the idea of Away's new 'White Lotus' luggage collab, specifically highlighting the dreamy aesthetic and the limited-edition collection's global launch on February 11th.
This post would showcase a visually appealing carousel of images, each building on a different aspect of the collab, such as the design process or the cultural inspiration behind it.
Your combined efforts would bring a unique and delightful perspective to the collection, creating a shared experience for your audience.
It would be a chance to showcase the beauty of the collection and the creative partnership that brought it to life.

Hi Away team,

We're a small Instagram content studio dedicated to bringing creative energy to the travel space. We'd like to propose a collaborative Instagram post that builds on the idea of Away's new 'White Lotus' luggage collab, specifically highlighting the dreamy aesthetic and the limited-edition collection's global launch on February 11th [P6]. This post would showcase a visually appealing carousel of images, each building on a different aspect of the collab, such as the design process or the cultural inspiration behind it. Your combined efforts would bring a unique and delightful perspective to the collection, creating a shared experience for your audience [P6]. It would be a chance to showcase the beauty of the collection and the creative partnership that brought it to life.

The BrandPilot team
